::: {#def-dfs}
#### Depth-first search

Let $G$ be a graph (@def-graph-vertices-edges) or a directed graph (@def-directed-graph) with no parallel edges (@def-parallel-edges),
given by an adjacency list (@def-adjacency-list), and let $s$ be a vertex of $G$.
**Depth-first search** [@wikipedia_depth_first_search] from $s$ is the recursive algorithm (@def-recursive-algorithm) `dfs`,
called as `dfs(G, s)` with no vertex marked:

```text
procedure dfs(G, v)
    mark v
    for each vertex u in the list of v, in order
        if u is not marked
            dfs(G, u)
```

All the calls share the same marks.

:::
